verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair axis for an email service, but the evidence pack contains no mention of any AI assistant inside Fastmail. The documented features are filters, templates, scheduled send, snooze, the JMAP API and API tokens, which are conventional features or developer building blocks rather than an agent users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
